units: <cite ref="Chullin 28a:11">Ḥull. 28ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>היכי נעביד נִשְׁחֲטֵיה … קשְׁחִיט</he> how shall we proceed? shall we cut it and then examine (the gullet)? Maybe it was cut at a perforated spot.
<cite ref="Megillah 7b:8">Meg. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>שַׁחֲטֵיה לר׳ וכ׳</he> he cut R. Zera’s throat; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>שְׁחִיט</he>, v. supra.
<cite ref="Chullin 4a:5">Ḥull. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה ש׳ שפיר</he> was properly cut.
